args.subject: Welcome to the Team, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're thrilled to have you joining our team next week.

I heard from Alice that you'll be working in the marketing department. Your background in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management sounds like a great fit, and we're all looking forward to working with you.

If you have any questions before your first day or need help settling in, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help.

Looking forward to meeting you in person!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
